_comment: Feeds Vocablo's Additional Resources feed (spec §4.16). Publish at https://getvocablo.com/resources.json. Strings may be plain (read as en-US) or maps of BCP-47 tags. `icon` is optional; use a square PNG. Decoding is strict — a malformed entry hides the whole list. Keep entries editorial (learning resources), never links that sell digital content outside the App Store.

description.en-US: Dictionary, conjugation tables, and grammar lessons — a great companion for looking words up in depth.
description.es-MX: Diccionario, tablas de conjugación y lecciones de gramática.

description.en-US: A Reddit community of learners and native speakers trading questions, tips, and resources. A friendly place to ask when a word or phrase has you stumped.
description.es-MX: Comunidad de Reddit donde estudiantes y hablantes nativos comparten preguntas, consejos y recursos.
